title: Prepare attributable migrations without source mutation
statement: The Interpretation and validation Module shall produce isolated model migration candidates from explicit source-to-target mappings, account for preserved and intentionally changed meaning, and expose target and consumer assessment limits before controlled adoption.

what.problem: Whole-model checks and migration preparation can hide incomplete rules or alter meaning while appearing valid.
what.desired_outcome: Prepare attributable migrations without source mutation.

why.rationale: SR-015 requires accountable diagnostics and candidate outcomes within MOD-003.

conditions: A participant requests selected-state conformance or an explicit model migration candidate.

contexts: MOD-003 logical request boundary and pure IF-002 operations over IF-001 captured input.

how.approach: Bind explicit source/profile/mapping scope, preserve all relevant findings and missingness, and return separate attributable mechanical, semantic and adoption limits.

how_much.scope: All parent SR-015 criteria for the selected finite model; capture custody, existing interpretation and later adoption retain their separate owners.

acceptance_criteria: Bind source state, both profiles, explicit mapping and target candidate membership/content in an inspectable transformation report.

Preserve stable identities and equivalent authoritative relationship meaning for representation changes; attribute every intentional addition, removal, identity or semantic change to its supplied basis.

Account for all included source content and report unmapped or unknown facts, unsupported transforms, ambiguous rule overlaps, target conflicts and failed or partial transformation without silent loss or repair.

Assess whole-model target conformance and each declared consumer against the exact candidate, retaining provenance, mismatches, unassessed checks and inventory completeness; required gaps withhold readiness.
Keep semantic preservation review, mechanical validity, consumer compatibility and controlled-adoption authority distinct; a complete candidate does not adopt the target profile.

Prepare only in isolated target buffers and preserve source content, historical profile meaning and current selection after failure, cancellation or abandonment; uncertain response cannot establish a completed available candidate.
constraints: Proposed Design only; no product runtime, current migration support, implementation or verification is claimed.

sources.basis: Derive whole-model diagnostics, separate mechanical/review presentation and source-preserving explicit migration candidates through MOD-003. Reuse capture, interpretation and scoped-check ownership; proposed Design only.
